summary: Fix movers command to use 'volume'/'value' as the index param instead of the dead 'INTRADAY' default; manually unwrap the {data:[...],timestamp} envelope.
reason: NSE's live-analysis-most-active-securities endpoint uses index=volume or index=value — not INTRADAY. The old default returned HTTP 200 with empty data. Response also has no 'status' field so extractResponseData didn't unwrap it.
validated_outcome: movers returns 20 items sorted by volume (IDEA first); movers --by value returns 20 items sorted by traded value.
